title: multi_ntfy: replace enabled bitset with inline flags
body:
Store enabled notification types in the low bits of a uint32_t and use the high bit for the pending-entry state.

This reduces curl_multi_ntfy to 40 bytes and removes an allocation from multi-handle initialization.
